lead: M. K. Stalin has built a public profile as an Indian politician, born on 1 March 1953 in Chennai.
As of 2026, he is 73 years old, and his birth date places him under the Pisces sign.
He has held the office of Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu and Deputy Chief Minister of Tamilnadu.
The sections that follow break down M. K. Stalin's biography into quick facts, early life, career history, personal life and a year-by-year timeline.

sections.heading: M. K. Stalin — Early Life, Family and Education
paras: M. K. Stalin was born on 1 March 1953 in Chennai, and holds Indian nationality.
Public records name his father, Muthuvel Karunanidhi and his mother, Dayalu Ammal. He is a sibling of M. K. Alagiri and Kanimozhi Karunanidhi.
He studied at Presidency College, University of Madras and Madras Christian College Higher Secondary School.
He is recorded as speaking Tamil.

sections.heading: M. K. Stalin — Career and Professional Work
paras: M. K. Stalin works primarily as a politician, actor and film producer.

He has held the following offices: Chief Minister of Tamil Nadu (2021–2026), Deputy Chief Minister of Tamilnadu (2009–2011), Mayor of Chennai (1996–2002), Member of the 14th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly (2011–2016), Member of the 16th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly (2021–present) and Member of the 9th Tamil Nadu Legislative Assembly. He is affiliated with Dravida Munnetra Kazhagam.

He is a parent to Udhayanidhi Stalin.
He is associated with Chennai as a place of residence.
